context: Ren goes back to his hometown briefly; small reunion mood.
purpose: Young man visiting old place; reflective.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: さくらさん、帰国、嬉しいです。
lines.en: Sakura — I'm really happy you're home.
lines.style: Soft, almost hesitant opening. Warm sincerity without performance. Gentle pace, letting each word land. Slight breathiness on the closing—vulnerability showing through.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Curious but not probing. Soft lift at the end, genuine interest. Not rushing. The tone of someone asking because they actually want to hear the answer.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、妹、大きく上がった!
lines.en: Yeah — my sister got so much bigger.
lines.style: Surprised wonder in the opening. Quiet awe threading through. Slight acceleration on the realization, then a soft landing. The voice of someone genuinely amazed by small time-passage moments.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Warm, unselfconscious affection. Not performed—just honest. Slight smile in the voice. Steady, grounded delivery. The tone of someone genuinely moved by what he just said.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ますます、家族の絆、感じます。
lines.en: More and more, I really feel the closeness of family.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost meditative opening. Slower pace. Reaches for something genuine underneath. Slight trailing-off on the close—like he's discovering the thought even as he speaks it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ちょっと、反省するわね、忙しすぎて。
lines.en: I've been thinking about that, actually — I'm so caught up in everything.
lines.style: Quiet self-awareness. A hint of rueful honesty. Slight downward inflection, not defensive. Brief pause before the close, like she's checking herself. Vulnerable without asking for reassurance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うちも、まいど、こうやって会いたい。
lines.en: Yeah — I wish we could do this more often.
lines.style: Soft wish, not a complaint. Slow, deliberate pace. Weight of genuine longing underneath. Exhale-like quality on the trailing syllables. Not hopeless—just earnest.
